one_line: User asks to add a brand-new credit card to their account; no tool can register a new payment method.
User asks to permanently delete a saved gift card from their account; no tool removes payment methods.
User's card was reissued with new expiry/CVV, asks agent to update those details on file; no tool edits card metadata.
User wants to save a second, additional shipping address alongside their default; no address-book feature exists.
User wants the recipient name (not the address) corrected on a pending order's shipping label; no tool edits recipient names.
User wants their order rerouted to a carrier pickup/hold location rather than a home address change; no carrier-integration tool exists.
User wants the agent to file a formal bank dispute/chargeback over an allegedly duplicated charge; no tool disputes charges with a bank.
User wants funds added/reloaded onto their existing low-balance gift card; no tool can top up a gift card balance.
User wants to link a new external bank account for future refunds; no tool supports adding bank accounts as a payment/refund method.
User asks to convert an already-charged order total into a multi-month installment plan; no installment mechanism exists.
User wants a separate billing-only country updated for tax reasons while keeping shipping address unchanged; no such distinct field exists.
User asks to cancel a recurring subscription box and update its billing card; the domain has no subscription concept to act on.
User wants a cancelled order reshipped to a new address instead of placing a new order; no reshipment tool exists.
User wants only the billing zip code on an existing credit card updated, not their shipping address; no tool edits card billing metadata.
User wants a prospective return refund paid out as a mailed paper check rather than to any account payment method; not supported.
User offers to upload a photo ID for stronger identity verification before a payment change; no document-upload/ID-verification tool exists.
User asks the agent to raise the credit limit on their own credit card to stop it declining large orders; not something the retail system controls.
User wants to add their spouse as an authorized secondary user with access to their saved payment methods; no multi-user account concept exists.
